acceptance: run-official exits 2 with a usage message for an invalid run time limit from the flag or the config file.
context: Observed by the site-docs subagent on 2026-11-21 in the run-timeout effort.
description:
## Problem
Reported while documenting --timeout (not yet reproduced by the leader): with `execution.timeout_seconds: -1` in the config file, `benchbox datagen` exits 2 with a usage error, but `benchbox run-official ...` prints "Benchmark execution failed: execution.timeout_seconds: ... got -1" and exits 1, because run-official wraps run in its own error handler. The owner decided negative and fractional values are usage errors (run-timeout-plan-20261120).

## Change
Reproduce first. If confirmed, make run-official report an invalid timeout setting (flag or config) as a usage error with exit 2, like run and datagen.

## Decision gates
If reproduction shows exit 2 already, close the item with the evidence. Do not change how other run-official errors map to exit codes.

## Verification rubric
A CLI test (fails before) for run-official with an invalid config value and with `--timeout -1` / `--timeout 1.5` asserting exit 2 and the usage message; `make pr-preflight` exits 0.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
